items.title: Morgan Stanley Investigates Misfired Email
items.description: Morgan Stanley is trying to figure out how a staffer accidentally leaked an email with highly confidential information. It contained a list of investment-banking deals the firm is working on in Asia.

items.title: Royal Caribbean Buys Stake in Sandals Resorts
items.description: Royal Caribbean Cruises agreed to buy a 50% stake in Sandals Resorts International for about $3 billion. Liana Baker has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Thames Creditors Plan New Rescue Deal to Avert State Control
items.description: Thames Water’s senior creditors are preparing to write off more debt and put more money into the utility in a renewed effort to avoid the UK government taking temporary control.

items.title: India’s RBI Sees Case for Rupee to Appreciate, Official Says
items.description: India’s rupee has room to appreciate from the current levels, Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said, striking an optimistic note on the currency after a period of recent weakness.

items.title: USD rallies after US data aided case for Federal Reserve increases
items.description: The dollar jumped Wednesday after US business activity rose at the fastest pace in more than five years, fortifying the case for the Federal Reserve to continue raising interest rates.

items.title: Gold Falls as Traders Weigh US-Iran Talk Progress, Fedspeak
items.description: Gold fell as traders monitored progress in talks between the US and Iran and comments by Federal Reserve officials for clues on how energy costs will influence the path forward for interest rates.

items.title: Reform Should Cut Back UK State Pension, Think Tank Says
items.description: A think tank linked to Reform UK has suggested that Nigel Farage’ party should reduce the state pension to a means-tested safety net, if it comes to power.

items.title: Stocks, Bonds Slip as Oil Jump Fuels Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
items.description: Stocks joined bonds lower as higher oil prices stoked worries about inflationary pressures, which were further bolstered by data showing jump in US business activity at the fastest pace since 2021.

items.title: Turkey Arrests Tera Chairman at Heart of Funds Scandal
items.description: Turkey arrested the brokerage founder at the center of an investigation into imploded stock funds that have caused billions of dollars of investors’ money to evaporate.
